summary.text: Steve Meskers was elected in November 2018 to represent the 150th House District in Greenwich and is House Chair of the Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: He has a B.A. in Economics and Spanish and an MBA, and a 35-year career in corporate lending, bankruptcy and international bond sales.
He has served 20 years on Greenwich's Representative Town Meeting and has lived in Greenwich for 25 years.
